item.title: Anthropic surges 27% in record $81B IPO, topping $2 trillion market cap on Nasdaq debut
item.description: Anthropic, the artificial-intelligence company behind chatbot Claude, made a historic stock-market debut Thursday, raising $81.3 billion in the largest initial public offering on record. item.title: ICJ rules Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya, orders reparations
item.description: The International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruled on Thursday that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, marking the first time a state has been found guilty of genocide by an international court. item.title: Manfred says MLB owners won't budge on salary cap, lockout looms
item.description: Major League Baseball Commissioner Rob Manfred said Wednesday that owners will not compromise on a salary cap and floor, a stance that risks a lockout when the current collective bargaining agreement expires. The two sides have roughly two weeks to reach a new deal before a potential work stoppage.
